- [IRET.28.16.3] **Regression cases** (explicit, named):
  full-table delete loop; long backward-shift chains;
  delete-then-reinsert storms; grow exactly at the boundary; tiny-cap
  collision storms; pointer-key + simulated slab reuse (free a key, reuse
  the address); `oa_list` heap overflow under `locked`.
